title: 12 Best Instagram Spots in Tokyo
description: Discover Tokyo's top 12 Instagram-worthy locations for stunning photos in 2026. From iconic cityscapes and ancient temples to futuristic art and vibrant street scenes, capture the essence of Japan's capital.

places.name: Shibuya Sky
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Capture the iconic 'Shibuya Scramble' from above, or a breathtaking wide shot of the sprawling Tokyo skyline. The reflective floor area is also popular for unique perspective photos.

places.name: Sensō-ji Temple
places.priceRange: Free (small purchases on Nakamise-dori from ¥200-500 approx. $1.50-3.50)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Kaminarimon Gate with its giant lantern, the main temple hall with its intricate details, and the five-story pagoda are all iconic shots. Don't forget to photograph the traditional snacks like agemanju on Nakamise-dori.

places.name: Takeshita Street
places.priceRange: Free to walk, snacks/drinks from ¥500-1500 (approx. $3-10) per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A giant rainbow cotton candy from Totti Candy Factory or a colorful crepe from one of the many crepe stands are classic Instagram shots here. Also, look for unique street style and vibrant shop facades.

places.name: teamLab Planets TOKYO
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Floating Flower Garden' and 'The Infinite Crystal Universe' are particularly photogenic, creating stunning, surreal backdrops for portraits and abstract shots. Experiment with slow shutter speeds for captivating light trails.

places.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Photos of the traditional teahouse reflecting in the pond, wide shots of the autumn leaves or cherry blossoms (seasonal), or the greenhouse interior for lush greenery shots.

places.name: Meiji Jingu Shrine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The giant wooden torii gate at the entrance to the forest path, the impressive rows of sake barrels and wine barrels, and the main shrine complex with its elegant architecture.

places.name: Tokyo Station (Marunouchi Building)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A wide shot of the entire Marunouchi facade from across the plaza, or detailed shots of the architectural elements and statues. Capture the reflection on the wet pavement after a rain shower for added drama.

places.name: Hie Shrine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Senbon Torii' (thousand torii gates) tunnel is the star attraction for photos, offering endless red lines leading uphill. Also capture the playful monkey statues, the shrine's guardians.

places.name: Nakameguro Canal
places.priceRange: Free to walk around, coffee/snacks from ¥600-1200 (approx. $4-8) per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A scenic photo of the canal, especially with cherry blossoms in spring, or a cozy shot from inside one of the waterside cafes. Grab an artisan coffee from a local roaster.

places.name: Starbucks Reserve Roastery Tokyo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A meticulously crafted coffee or tea beverage, capturing the stunning interior design with its dramatic copper accents and abundance of natural light. The outdoor terraces also offer great views.

places.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observation Decks
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A wide-angle shot of the sprawling Tokyo metropolis, focusing on landmarks like the Tokyo Tower or the unique angles of the Shinjuku skyscrapers.

places.name: Robot Restaurant
places.priceRange: ¥8,500-10,000 (approx. $58-68) for show per person, food/drinks extra
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Capture the colorful chaos of the robots and dancers in action, particularly during the climax of a show segment where lights and sound are at their peak. Think action shots!
